Container.Name: ChatGPT-Community
Container.Overview: ChatGPT Community as a single application: no XFCE desktop or taskbar. Includes experimental Remote Mobile Control, persistent credentials and separately authorized SSH access. Optional Intel/AMD GPU acceleration and optional WebUI password. Keep access on a trusted LAN/VPN; without a password anyone who can reach the WebUI can use the application.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Keep the existing path to preserve login, pairing and SSH keys

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Intel/AMD rendering and encoding; remove this device when the host has no /dev/dri

Config.Name: WebUI username (optional)
Config.Description: Only used when a WebUI password is set; unrelated to your ChatGPT account

Config.Name: WebUI password (optional)
Config.Description: Leave blank for no WebUI login (trusted LAN/VPN only). Set a strong unique password to enable login.

Config.Name: Wayland
Config.Description: Use Wayland/labwc; false selects the single-app X11 fallback

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Container user ID; retain the existing value on upgrade

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Container group ID; retain the existing value on upgrade

Config.Name: Unraid Host
Config.Description: Your server hostname or IP for optional SSH access. Generic default: unraid. Only used for a new SSH configuration; existing config is preserved.
